ideas.name: Texture Treasure Hunt
ideas.how: Place 3 textures in a basket—silky, bumpy, crinkly. Let baby explore while you name each one.

ideas.name: Scent Parade
ideas.how: Introduce one gentle scent at a time: vanilla, orange, lavender. Say the scent name before baby smells.

ideas.name: Voice Hide & Seek
ideas.how: From left and right sides of the crib, say baby’s name. Pause and let them find your voice.

ideas.name: Clap & Sing Time
ideas.how: Clap a simple rhythm and hum. Let baby feel the vibration on your hands.

ideas.name: Love Light Prayer
ideas.how: Hold baby over your heart. Whisper a short blessing while breathing slowly together.
